title: An injective integral extension preserves Krull dimension
statement: Let $R\hookrightarrow S$ be an injective homomorphism of commutative rings such that every element of $S$ is integral over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. Then the Krull dimensions [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] of $R$ and $S$ are equal: $\dim R=\dim S$.
